description.value: At 16th level, anyone wanting to attack the psychic must make a successful Will save (DC 10 + half of the psychic's level + her Intelligence modifier) or it can't follow through with the attack, that part of its action is lost, and they take a -1 penalty to all saving throws against abilities by the psychic until the end of their next turn. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to this effect for 24 hours. By spending 1 point of her phrenic pool as a move action, the psychic can share this ability with all allies within 30 ft. for one round. This is a mind-affecting effect.
